thread:
cecilia: heads up  noticed a bunch of quota hits attributed to the wrong project this morning. looks like the x-origin-project header is getting dropped between auth-exchange and the routing layer.
owen: can you paste an example log? is it dropped only for certain regions or tenants?
prakash: sample from staging proxy: `incoming: headers={x-origin-project: proj-acme-42, authorization: Bearer ...}` then downstream: `upstream: headers={authorization: Bearer ..., x-origin-project: <missing>}`. looks like the gateway strip rule ran.
lina: that would cause fallback attribution to org-default project and inflate that project's quota usage. console shows a sudden jump for proj-default and drop for proj-acme-42.
cecilia: telemetry idea: emit `auth_exchange_header_dropped_total{header="x-origin-project"}` whenever the exchange notices the header removed (best-effort). also add `origin_project` label to `api_requests_total` at the ingress so we can compute an attribution diff.
owen: promql to detect mismatches: `sum by (origin_project) (increase(api_requests_total[5m])) - sum by (origin_project) (increase(issued_to_project_total[5m]))` we can alert when delta > 0 for >5m.
prakash: small mitigation: have auth-exchange rewrite `x-origin-project` into `x-origin-project-sig` (compact hash) and obey a allowlist so the gateway doesn't strip it. behind flag `auth.exchange.rewrite_origin=true`.
lina: UX: add an "attributed_via" column on the quota page that shows whether attribution came from header, token, or default. when mismatch detected show a tiny warning icon with tooltip: "header propagation missing  see runbook".
cecilia: rollout plan: PR adds the rewrite + `auth_exchange_header_dropped_total` metric + flag. canary 1% traffic in us-east for 30m. gating: no 5xx increase, attributed_via header fraction >= 99% for top 20 tenants. if dropped_total > 0 escalate sampling to 25% for affected tenants.
owen: i'll add the prometheus recording rule and a grafana panel comparing header-attributed vs token-attributed counts per project. will also add an explainer note in the console modal.
deploy-bot: deploy started: auth-exchange/canary -> k8s-redwood/us-east-1 (id: deploy-2026-05-20-014) :rocket:
prakash: i'll run the promql in staging and paste a quick diff. if gateway refuses the rewrite we may need an infra change to passthrough the header.
cecilia: thanks all. once canary is clean we'll roll the dashboard change and the runbook. :thumbsup:
